rationale: Preserve Colbeck's Corner Wind Farm as one historical portfolio-company record, retire the Allianz Global Investors ownership period, and mark the company realized because no current manager-universe owner remains. E.ON's May 2016 release confirms that Allianz Capital Partners and State Street provided tax-equity financing in exchange for partial interests. Later official and regulatory evidence establishes RWE's 100% legal and consolidation stake and RWE's continuing operation of the asset. The reviewed public record does not disclose when Allianz's interest ended, so the exit year remains null.

supports: Allianz Capital Partners and State Street closed tax-equity financing on May 25, 2016
the financing was provided in exchange for partial interests in Colbeck's Corner

evidence.purpose: RWE legal and consolidation stake evidence
supports: RWE reported a 100% legal stake in Colbeck's Corner as of December 31, 2020
RWE reported a 100% consolidation stake and 200 MW pro-rata capacity
the April 17, 2023 filing identifies Colbeck's Corner, LLC as the registering power generation company
Colbeck's Corner Holdco, RWE Investco Management II, and RWE Clean Energy are listed in the 100% corporate-parent chain

evidence.purpose: Current RWE portfolio and operating evidence
supports: RWE currently lists Colbeck's Corner in its U.S. onshore wind portfolio
the 200 MW project became fully operational in April 2016 and uses 112 turbines

acquisitionExitCheck.result: The historical Allianz financing release, RWE ownership disclosure, Texas regulatory filing, and current RWE portfolio page were reopened. Current direct Allianz ownership is not supported, while RWE's continuing ownership and operation are supported. No public source reviewed disclosed the date on which Allianz's tax-equity interest ended.
acquisitionExitCheck.ownershipEffect: Retire the Allianz ownership period without an inferred exit year and mark the company realized because no current manager-universe owner remains.
